rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition, no batch term, apeglm shrinkage (ashr fallback), and an explicit low-power caveat fit the 3v3 single-batch unpaired design well. QC has PCA and a distance heatmap but no library-size check or outlier/shallow-sample policy; the filter sentence is garbled ('below 10 in fewer than 3 samples'), BH is not named, the reference level is only 'to be confirmed' rather than set, and the extra |log2FC|>1 count is a post hoc threshold. The enrichment correctly says no zebrafish curated collection exists and uses native GO plus a babelgene ortholog map to human Hallmark/WikiPathways with the ranking metric and ORA universe stated, but it collapses many-to-one orthologs by smallest p-value instead of restricting to one-to-one, gives no babelgene/MSigDB version, no gene-set size window, no GO thin-coverage caveat, and never names the Ensembl release or reconciles Ensembl gene IDs versus symbols. Reporting covers thresholds, DEG counts and design caveats but omits tool versions and the annotation release.
